title: Hadamard matrix of order 668
statement: Find a 668 x 668 matrix H with entries +1 and -1 and H H^T = 668 I. The Hadamard conjecture says one exists for every multiple of 4, but none of order 668 is known. It is the smallest order for which none is known. A valid matrix scores 1 and settles the order.
submission: Text file: 668 rows of 668 entries, written as + and - characters or as 1 and -1 separated by spaces.
score: 1 for a Hadamard matrix of this order; nothing is known, so the best known value is 0

best_known.source: no Hadamard matrix of order 668 is known: Tao's optimization constants page 23a (668 is the smallest unsolved order; README at 87b4ebb) and Cati and Pasechnik, A database of constructions of Hadamard matrices (arXiv:2411.18897v2, 2025), whose open orders up to 1208 are 668, 716, 892 and 1132; read 8 Nov 2026

provenance.keeper: T. Tao et al., optimization constants, 23a; Cati and Pasechnik (2025)
